summary: Zymeworks Inc. files an 8-K disclosing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Theravance Biopharma Inc. on June 28, 2026. Theravance stockholders will receive $17.00 in cash per ordinary share plus one contingent value right (CVR) representing potential additional cash payments. The deal values Theravance at an implied equity value of approximately $963.6 million based on shares outstanding as of the filing, representing a premium of roughly 47.5% over the unaffected closing price of $11.53 on June 25, 2026. Both companies' boards have approved the transaction, with Theravance's board acting on unanimous recommendation of a strategic review committee. The merger is subject to Theravance shareholder approval, regulatory clearances, and customary closing conditions, expected to close in Q4 2026. Zymeworks is financing the cash consideration through existing cash and committed debt financing. Post-close, Theravance will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary focused on gastrointestinal and pulmonary programs. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory milestones affecting CVR payouts.
